title: Skull Eye Surreal Bloom
description: A surreal painting features a cracked white and gold skull with a glowing yellow eye and green foliage growing from its cranium, adorned with vibrant poppies and magenta flowers. Below it, a massive dripping dark red organic mass contains a huge detailed eye with a skull-filled iris, surrounded by more flowers, skulls, butterflies, and broken clock faces against a dark gradient background.
prompt: surreal dark art painting of a cracked white and gold skull with one glowing yellow eye, green brain-like foliage and colorful poppies growing from its head, positioned above a massive dripping visceral dark red orb containing a giant realistic eye whose iris is filled with tiny skulls, surrounded by red and purple poppies with skull centers, broken clock faces with spiderwebs, butterflies, against a moody dark gradient sky
